name: Fog Cloud
summary: A 20-foot-radius Sphere of fog that is Heavily Obscured.
text: A 20-foot-radius Sphere of fog fills the area around a point within range. The Sphere is Heavily Obscured. It lasts for the duration unless a strong wind, such as one from Gust of Wind, blows it away. Concentration, up to 1 hour. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: the radius increases by 20 feet for each slot level above 1.
